hero.body: Bespoke suits, women’s tailoring and luxury kaftans for work, weddings and important occasions.

remote.title: Remote measurements are checked before production.
remote.body: Any alteration or remake terms are stated with your quote before payment.

collections.body: See the cut and proportion before you book. Save any reference you want to discuss.

process.body: Each stage is clear before the next one begins.

founder.title: Built through the work.
founder.body: OVOSKG grew from hands-on tailoring into a structured bespoke company. The focus is the garment, the agreed fit and the service around the order.
founder.imageCaption: A better garment starts with a clear process.

conversion.title: Tell OVOSKG what you want to make.

materials.title: The cloth changes the whole garment.
materials.body: Explore material directions before you start the brief. OVOSKG confirms the exact composition, weight, colour and availability with your quote.
materials.note: Material names below are design directions, not a live stock list.

collections.title: Choose the garment first.
collections.intro: Browse references for men’s suits, women’s suits and kaftans. Save anything you want OVOSKG to discuss with you.

mens-bespoke.title: Men's bespoke suits
mens-bespoke.intro: Choose the cut you prefer. OVOSKG adjusts the shape, cloth and details to your measurements.

womens-bespoke.title: Women's bespoke suits
womens-bespoke.intro: Use these references to show the jacket length, trouser shape and level of structure you prefer.

luxury-kaftan.title: Luxury men's kaftans
luxury-kaftan.intro: Choose how simple or detailed the garment should be. OVOSKG confirms the cloth, embroidery and fit before production.

shop.title: Browse the current references.
shop.intro: Filter by category, save the pieces you like and use them when you submit your order brief.

lookbook.title: Men’s suits. Women’s suits. Kaftans.
lookbook.intro: Use the lookbook to show OVOSKG the shape, cloth and level of detail you prefer.

bespoke.title: Tell us what you want made.
bespoke.intro: Choose the garment, occasion, preferred date and fitting method. OVOSKG confirms the details and price before payment.

measurements.title: Send your measurements for review.
measurements.intro: OVOSKG checks remote measurements before cutting. If a number looks wrong, the team can ask you to measure again or join a short video check.

track.title: Check the current stage of your order.
track.intro: Use the order ID from your confirmation message to see the latest production update.

about.title: From tailoring work to OVOSKG.
about.intro: The company developed from hands-on clothing work into a bespoke service for suits, kaftans and custom orders.

company.title: The team behind each order.
company.intro: OVOSKG separates design, production and client service so responsibilities stay clear throughout the order.

contact.title: Speak with OVOSKG.
contact.intro: Send an enquiry, request a fitting or ask about an order. Remote clients are welcome.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: How OVOSKG handles information shared through enquiries, measurements, fittings and website interactions.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: The practical terms that apply when you enquire about or commission custom work from OVOSKG.

delivery.title: Delivery policy
delivery.intro: How collection, dispatch and delivery timing are handled for OVOSKG orders.

returns.title: Alterations and returns
returns.intro: How fit concerns, workmanship issues and bespoke return requests are reviewed.
